title: Salesforce makes Agentforce generally available with the Einstein Trust Layer and an agent audit trail
summary: On 29 October 2024 Salesforce announced the general availability of Agentforce, a platform for building agents that it says can autonomously take action across business functions, with examples including resolving service cases, qualifying leads, and handling orders, reservations, and deliveries. The release describes the Einstein Trust Layer (zero data retention, toxicity detection, secure data retrieval, dynamic grounding), an Audit Trail that gives customers data to track agent actions and outputs for compliance with security, privacy, regulatory, and AI governance policies, and Agent Builder, in which admins define topics, write natural-language instructions per topic, and assemble a library of actions the agent can choose from, with escalation and hand-off to human reps.
